entities.summary: Rommel Agmed Pacheco Marrufo is a Mexican politician and retired diver. He was a six-time Pan American Games medalist. In the 2004 Summer Olympics he finished in 10th place in the 10-meter platform and 3-meter springboard. In the 2008 Summer Olympics he finished in 8th place in the 10-meter platform.
